transactionsDescription: View and manage all your cryptocurrency payment transactions
settlementWalletHint: Funds are sent here only after the payment is received and confirmed on-chain.
awaitingPaymentTitle: Awaiting payment — no funds received yet
awaitingPaymentBody: We haven't detected an on-chain deposit for this payment, so nothing has been sent to your wallet yet. This entry will update automatically once the customer's funds arrive and are confirmed.
statusTipConverted: Settled and auto-converted to your payout currency.
statusTipPending: Waiting for the buyer's payment to appear on the blockchain.
statusTipConfirming: Payment seen on-chain — waiting for enough confirmations.
statusTipSettled: Confirmed and credited to your balance.
statusTipFailed: This payment did not complete — no funds moved.
statusTipUnpaid: The buyer opened the checkout but has not paid yet.
statusTipAwaiting: No payment received yet — this address is waiting for the buyer to send funds.
exportScopedHint: Exports the {{count}} rows matching your filters and the active status chip.
exportSettledHint: Exports only settled payments matching your filters.
exportAllHint: Exports every row matching your filters as CSV.
